why: Round 1 review, Claude must-fix 8: a pasted dialogue. Every line is a short all-CJK run, so under the first pair rule the paste reached 100% coverage and came back as two proper-noun cards (小明, 小红) with the other speaker's line as the meaning. MIN_WORDS is 2, so the games opened broken. A definition now has to be half again its term's length AND carry a function word or a full stop, which no turn of a dialogue does.
